items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: I didn't hear Zutty in person. The first time I heard Zutty in person was when he was with Roy Eldridge at the Three Deuces in Chicago.

ctx.x:
Well, we've got the phone all straight.
We were talking about Zutty Singleton.
Yeah. The first time I heard Zutty was on record. I heard him with Louis Armstrong when he did 'West End Blues'.
